notes.title: Eyebrows.
notes.text: A lot more eyebrow support, including annually recurring events like Black Friday, Election Results, and many more.

notes.title: Star ratings.
notes.text: Star ratings from Letterboxd wrap to their own line (my favorite detail in this release).

notes.title: Dynamic title typography.
notes.text: Title size and width is scaled for length and device size.

notes.title: Hanging quotes.
notes.text: Quotation marks hang outside the text edge.

notes.title: Tables.
notes.text: Tables fit their content, sit centered, and keep the author’s alignment.

notes.title: Eyebrows.
notes.text: Eyebrows are now poppy, with other color, spacing, and typography refinements.

notes.title: Media height.
notes.text: Media height is capped so it never overflows the window.

notes.title: Code blocks.
notes.text: Code now has syntax highlighting, shows the language, and has a Copy button.

notes.title: Tall media.
notes.text: Images, videos and embeds stay centered and stay fully in-view.

notes.title: Update notices.
notes.text: When a newer release exists, a short note and link to update appears at the end of articles. Daisy and Daisy Sans check one small file on this project's GitHub Pages site at most once a day, and send nothing about you, your feeds or your articles.

notes.title: Lead lists.
notes.text: Links in a list at the start of a post no longer shift when you hover over them.
